title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 4rth August 2026 || TV5 News | TV5 Money

recommendations.note: Without any doubt, M&M - will give good profits. Chosen over Tata Motors and Eicher Motors.
recommendations.detail: Caller Shiva asked the analyst to choose between Tata Motors, Eicher Motors, and M&M in the auto sector. Kutumba Rao said without any doubt M&M -- buy it, it will give good profits.

recommendations.price: near 52-week high; wait for result before buying fresh
recommendations.note: Hold if already bought; if not, wait for the result. Negative: promoters have pledged shares heavily.
recommendations.detail: Caller Shiva asked about NRB Bearings. Kutumba Rao said it is trading near its 52-week highs, recently becoming active with volumes coming regularly. Last quarter result was very good; this quarter's result is yet to come. Hold if already bought; if not bought, wait for the result. One negative: the promoters have pledged a large portion of shares, so sudden volatile moves are possible -- be prepared.

recommendations.note: Near 52-week high, hyperactive; QIP done recently with good investors. Hold with SL 200.
recommendations.detail: Same caller asked about Bell Rice Industries. Kutumba Rao said it is also at 52-week highs, continuously hyperactive with high volumes. Fancy has increased recently. They did a QIP very recently with good institutional investors, so the stock should remain stable. Hold with a stop loss around 200.

recommendations.note: Near 52-week high, high potential, diversifying. Target 200 within 6 months if 150-152 crossed.
recommendations.detail: Shravan Reddy has 35% profit in Jamuna Auto and asked whether to continue holding. Kutumba Rao said both (Jamuna Auto and Deepak Nitrite) have recently become very active. Jamuna Auto is near its 52-week high with high potential, and the stock is diversifying. Hold with a trailing stop around 125-130. If the 150-152 levels are crossed, the stock can go to 200 within six months.

recommendations.note: Hold - mentioned together with Jamuna Auto, both recently very active.
recommendations.detail: Same caller (Shravan Reddy) has 35% profit in Deepak Nitrite. Kutumba Rao mentioned both stocks together as recently very active and said to hold. No separate stop loss or target was given for Deepak Nitrite.

recommendations.price: buy on dips/cool-off; take in 2-3 lots
recommendations.note: Hyderabad-based defence company. Was given in Vijayawada workshop - now delivering gains. Buy on dips.
recommendations.detail: Srinivas Jyothula asked about DigiLogic for the long term. Kutumba Rao said they gave it in the Vijayawada workshop; it did not rise for a few days but has now given very good gains. A Hyderabad-based defence-sector company with good promoters. Buy when it cools off, in 2-3 lots rather than all at once.

recommendations.note: High-priced stock in precision engineering. Wait for a significant correction before buying.
recommendations.detail: Same mail asked about Jyothi CNC for the long term. Kutumba Rao said it is a somewhat high-priced stock. Precision engineering companies are seeing increased activity, but for Jyothi CNC he would say wait for a significant correction and then buy.

recommendations.price: bought at 3500, now at 3145; wait for 3250 to be crossed
recommendations.note: Slight technical downtrend visible. Good long-term bet but wait until 3250 is crossed before buying.
recommendations.detail: Vaishali bought Acuitas Chemicals at 3500 and asked whether to accumulate after mixed results. Kutumba Rao said he saw an interesting broker report -- looks like a good long-term bet but patience is needed. Technically a slight downtrend is visible at 3145 vs. 3500. Wait until it crosses 3250 before buying more.

recommendations.price: bought at 247; exit on rallies post-result
recommendations.note: Weak as of now. Hold among UCO Bank/NCC/Suzlon - NCC is the one he would keep if forced to choose.
recommendations.detail: Pratap Reddy from Chennai holds UCO Bank (31), NCC (247), and Suzlon (62) for long term. Kutumba Rao said all three are weak. NCC result is still to come; analyse post-results and gradually exit on rallies. If forced to hold one, he said hold NCC. UCO Bank and Suzlon should also be exited on rallies.

recommendations.note: Hold and can average. Loan book growing steadily. Will become a larger housing finance company in 2 years.
recommendations.detail: Satyanarayana Raju holds Bajaj Housing Finance at Rs 145 average and asked whether to average down. Kutumba Rao said hold and you can average as well. The loan book is growing well and steadily. Within the next two years it will become one of the larger housing finance companies. Patience is needed -- don't expect immediate returns.
